Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the BERT-base encoder and the Transformer encoder from "Attention Is All You Need" both have 12 layers, resulting in a difference of 0. This is a factual error. The original Transformer paper ("Attention Is All You Need") specifies an encoder with **6 identical layers**, whereas BERT-base specifies a **12-layer** encoder. The confusion likely arose from misinterpreting the internal structure of the Transformer layers (which contain two sublayers: multi-head attention and a position-wise feed-forward network) as additional layers, or simply recalling the wrong number for the original paper. The correct calculation is 12 (BERT) - 6 (Transformer) = 6 more blocks in BERT-base.
